nodes.label: Elsewhere (product) / Radio Passport (heritage)
nodes.rationale: Heritage repo name Radio Passport, product name Elsewhere, tagline 'You are not here.' Live at https://elsewheremusic.com; old radiopassport.art 308-redirects to it.

nodes.label: Elsewhere Hard Rules
nodes.rationale: Never charge to hear radio; never invent ICY titles; never put AI on the audio path; never AbortController.abort() a Remix fetch (use Promise.race); do not commit .env; keep public/FTS.jpeg 404 wallpaper. These protect the free, honest, human-audio ethos of the product.

nodes.label: Voice Vocabulary (allowed and banned words)
nodes.rationale: Allowed: land, dusk, hour, stamp, live, cover, elsewhere, now. Banned: discover, seamless, AI-powered, widget, playlist, unlock, explore. Enforces the travel-by-radio voice and excludes generic SaaS language.

nodes.label: App Architecture Map (Room writer/reader contracts)
nodes.rationale: PlayerDock.tsx is the only Room writer; roomStore.ts holds current land (ICY, caption, plate, dossier); listen.tsx theater reads the Room; root.tsx hosts the audio bridge and 404; radio-passport components own globe, intent, overlays, stamps.

nodes.label: Route Model: departure hall, theater, room
nodes.norm_label: route model: departure hall, theater, room

nodes.label: Audio Ownership Rule (playerStore + GlobalAudioBridge)
nodes.rationale: playerStore + GlobalAudioBridge own audio; playback must never stop on filter/search changes so listening feels like a continuous broadcast.

nodes.label: Heuristics AI Gateway (Flash only)
nodes.rationale: AI_PROVIDER=heuristics against HEURISTICS_BASE_URL; local stack uses heuristics plus deepseek-v4-flash, production uses Gemini 2.5 Flash; model env vars cannot override Flash. Interpret, dispatch, recommend endpoints.

nodes.label: --stamp-ink Progress Variable (commit ae63cf4)
nodes.rationale: JourneyBridge.tsx publishes --stamp-ink (0..1) on documentElement once per second while the current city plays unstamped; resets on station change/pause/stamp; reduced motion never receives the var; fill is a lacquer conic-gradient on .ew-stamp-ring outside any @layer.

nodes.label: Ticket-Stub Passport Stamps (commit ccdd951)
nodes.rationale: PassportOverlay stamps styled as boarding-pass stubs (.rp-stamp-ticket) with CSS-mask side notches, dashed tear line, and tear-off strip carrying local time/date/telemetry from stored stamp data.

nodes.label: Halftone Grain Overlay (commit ccdd951)
nodes.rationale: halftone.ts builds a fixed 6x6 dot tile once and reuses it as a CanvasPattern stamped over washes in ParticleGlobe.tsx (alpha .05), GalaxyBackdrop.tsx (.07), TheaterWell.tsx (.06); skipped under reduced motion; strictly pattern-based, no per-pixel loops.

nodes.label: Intent Echo (commit 6a2a77e)
nodes.rationale: productFlow.ts pure helper intentEchoFromInterpret(prompt, intent): language rewrite wins, identical/whitespace-equal query returns null; _index.tsx guards staleness with queryRef so a slow interpret response cannot whisper over retyped text; echo cleared on any IntentBar keystroke.

nodes.label: House Rules Restated for Review
nodes.rationale: Restates AGENTS.md hard rules and voice ban list; adds that app/tailwind.css has formatting-locked compact rules asserted by tests and contract tests are law (fix code, never weaken assertions).

nodes.label: Full Quality Gate (183 tests / 22 files, typecheck, eslint)
nodes.norm_label: full quality gate (183 tests / 22 files, typecheck, eslint)

nodes.label: Hidden Filter State Problem
nodes.rationale: Mood/place chips hide toggle-off semantics, switching MOOD/PLACE preserves the previous value invisibly, text queries are ANDed with lingering filters, and empty results never explain which constraint caused them - the state feels locked.

nodes.label: Filter Interaction Contract (All moods / All places / Clear search)
nodes.rationale: One obvious model: MOOD and PLACE mutually exclusive with explicit All moods / All places reset chips; free-text search global and taking precedence (prefer clearing constraints); visible Clear search affordance; accessible aria-pressed state, 44px targets, reduced-motion compatibility.
nodes.norm_label: filter interaction contract (all moods / all places / clear search)

nodes.label: Modest Typo Recovery (trans -> trance)
nodes.rationale: Add typo/prefix recovery for common music vocabulary ('trans' should suggest trance) without broad fuzzy matching that floods results with irrelevant stations.

nodes.label: Station Availability Honesty (no stale Healthy labels)
nodes.rationale: Never call a station Healthy solely from stale catalog metadata (phase two showed checks ~7 months old); represent evidence age honestly, e.g. 'Not recently verified'; prefer recently verified stations in ranking.
nodes.norm_label: station availability honesty (no stale healthy labels)

nodes.label: Bounded Live Probe Shelf (server/stations/probe.ts)
nodes.rationale: Live-probe only a bounded leading shelf with concurrency limits, short timeouts, caching and SSR/Vercel safety; reuse server/stations/probe.ts but verify its HEAD/Range strategy against streaming endpoints.

nodes.label: Auto-Skip Transparency
nodes.rationale: When playback recovery substitutes a station, the warning must stay visible long enough and clearly name both the failed requested station and the replacement now playing in the dock.

nodes.label: Catalog Snapshot Payload Reduction
nodes.rationale: Search merged query results with the full 8,000-station snapshot (q=malayalam returned 8,064 objects); reduce the payload so focused queries do not ship the whole snapshot.

nodes.label: React Hydration Errors #418/#423
nodes.rationale: Production console emitted React hydration errors #418 and #423 during the audit; investigate and eliminate them rather than suppressing console output.

nodes.label: Signal & Stamp Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: One nocturnal shortwave system replaces mixed legacy styles (retro tuner, neumorphic tab bar, beige Mantine theme, AI-generated imagery). High fidelity: recreate pixel-perfectly in Remix/React/Tailwind, wiring demo data to the real Radio Browser catalog.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (charcoal/paper/coral/teal, Sora + IBM Plex Mono)
nodes.rationale: charcoal #14120F background, surface #1C1915, paper #F2EDE4 text, muted #A89F90, coral #E5535F the ONLY accent, signal teal #6FB5C4 on-air status only; dashed 1.5px border = perforation motif for anything passport-related; Sora for display/UI, IBM Plex Mono for telemetry.
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (charcoal/paper/coral/teal, sora + ibm plex mono)

nodes.label: Particle Globe Spec
nodes.rationale: ~300 background particles on a fibonacci sphere, rotation 0.0022 rad/frame pausing on city hover, front-hemisphere coral city dots, playing city in signal teal with pulse, canvas-drawn tooltip, ~30 prominent dots max, DPR<=2, pause when document.hidden, respect reduced motion.

nodes.label: Atlas Overlay Spec (country index)
nodes.rationale: Full-screen 44-country index in six regions; country/language search; language shown as a first-class facet on every row; drill-down groups stations under city eyebrows with Top Picks for big countries, never a flat 2,000-row list.

nodes.label: Stamp Mechanic (dwell-to-ink)
nodes.rationale: Listening to a station in an unstamped city for 60 seconds (prototype tweak: 15s) inks the stamp and fires a bottom-right PASSPORT STAMPED toast; timer cancels on station change or pause; 'Stay long enough to be stamped.'

nodes.label: Single Player Dock Spec
nodes.rationale: One dock everywhere replaces separate mini/premium/compact player variants; artwork is a live particle-ring canvas whose orbit radius tracks amplitude, hue seeded from station id.

nodes.label: Prototype State Model (mode/mood/place/stamps/played)
nodes.rationale: mode (mood|place), mood, place, country, query, now, playing, favs, played, stamps (cityId -> station/freq/date), overlay flags; prev/next steps through the currently filtered pool wrapping; persist stamps/favs/played per user in the real backend.

nodes.label: Logo Mark: a stamp that broadcasts
nodes.rationale: Perforated coral stamp ring + transmitter dot + two signal arcs; reads as a passport stamp at rest and a live antenna in motion. Coral arc = you; paper arc = the world answering.
nodes.norm_label: logo mark: a stamp that broadcasts

nodes.label: One Accent Color Rule
nodes.rationale: Coral carries every interactive and live moment; signal teal reserved for on-air status only; everything else charcoal and paper - no gradients as decoration, no purple glows, no beige surfaces.

nodes.label: Particles, Not Pictures
nodes.rationale: Every station gets generative artwork: station ID seeds a hue and a particle ring, playback drives amplitude. Replaces AI-generated images entirely - zero asset cost, consistent identity, cheap 2D canvas on mobile. Caps: ~max 300 particles, DPR<=2, pause when tab hidden, respect reduced motion.

nodes.label: Content Scale Model (chips vs Atlas)
nodes.rationale: Chips are shortcuts (near you, featured, recent) never the taxonomy; the Atlas (region -> country -> top stations) is the canonical index for 100+ countries; language is searchable and first-class; the globe is a complement capped at ~30 brightest signals - it invites, Atlas and search deliver breadth.

nodes.label: Type System (Sora display, Plex Mono telemetry)
nodes.norm_label: type system (sora display, plex mono telemetry)

nodes.label: v2 Globe Canvas Implementation
nodes.rationale: requestAnimationFrame loop draws fibonacci-sphere particles, dashed coral ring, lat/lon city dots (front hemisphere z>0.05), canvas-drawn hover tooltip with rounded rect, click sets mode=place; DPR capped at 2 and rotation pauses on hover.

nodes.label: v2 Station Pool Filter (query ANDed with mode)
nodes.rationale: pool() concatenates all demo stations then filters by free-text query across name/tags/city/country/language/moods; otherwise filters by active place/country or mood depending on mode. Chips toggle off on second tap but no explicit reset chip exists - the exact shape later criticized in the availability handoff.
nodes.norm_label: v2 station pool filter (query anded with mode)

nodes.label: v2 Demo Dataset (10 cities, 44-country atlas)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder data: Tokyo, Kochi, Mumbai, Paris, Lagos, Seattle, Chicago, Rio, Reykjavik, Beirut with per-station moods; 44-country region table with 9 populated codes; to be replaced by the Radio Browser catalog.

nodes.label: Intent Bar (Ask / Speak a destination / Surprise)
nodes.rationale: Textbox 'Ask for a place, language, mood, or station' with placeholder 'Lisbon at dusk, Malayalam night...', plus Speak-a-destination voice button and Surprise button - the natural-language entry to landing somewhere.
nodes.norm_label: intent bar (ask / speak a destination / surprise)

nodes.label: LIVE NOW Station Shelf with Favorites
nodes.rationale: 'Also at this hour' suggestions plus LIVE NOW rows (play button, station + place, mono bitrate/format like 128K MP3, favorite heart) - playback controls living beside discovery.
nodes.norm_label: live now station shelf with favorites

nodes.label: Interactive Globe (30 live cities)
nodes.rationale: Application labelled 'Interactive globe with 30 live cities. Hover or tap a dot to read the place, then click to land.' with readout like '320 - NEW YORK - LAND - 10:50'.

nodes.label: Passport Stamp Counter Chip
nodes.rationale: Header button 'Open passport, N places stamped' showing zero-padded count (00, 01, 02) across sessions.

nodes.label: Arrival / Re-entry / Departure States
nodes.rationale: First visit shows 'EW - Arrival / Land here'; returning shows 'EW - Re-entry / Continue in <city>' with local time and daypart; Room when empty shows 'EW - Departure / Back to Elsewhere'. Copy: 'Stay long enough to be stamped.'

nodes.label: Empty Room State ('The room is empty.')
nodes.rationale: 'Land somewhere first. Then come back.' with EW - Departure link home - the Room refuses to open before a first landing.
nodes.norm_label: empty room state ('the room is empty.')

nodes.label: Lacquer Seal (favicon-derived)
nodes.rationale: SVG seal of concentric gold rings around a red lacquer center, taken from /elsewhere-favicon.svg; anchors the top-right of the social card.

nodes.label: OG Still Brand Palette (night-earth washes)
nodes.rationale: #0C0B09 ground, #E8DFD0 paper type, #C73A3A lacquer red, #C6A56A foil gold, #7EB8B4 city-light teal; nebula washes echo GalaxyBackdrop; fonts Schibsted Grotesk, Azeret Mono, Newsreader italic coverline 'You are not here.'

nodes.label: Heuristics LiteLLM Gateway
nodes.rationale: First-choice local AI provider when a key is present; keeps AI cost low by pinning the model in code.

nodes.label: DeepSeek V4 Flash
nodes.rationale: Locked to deepseek-v4-flash in app/services/ai/gateway.ts to keep cost down; HEURISTICS_MODEL in .env is ignored for routing.

nodes.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
nodes.rationale: Production default because Vercel has no Heuristics URL; free tier with better writing than Flash-Lite; Pro is paid-only and not the default.

nodes.label: /api/now-playing-trivia
nodes.rationale: Dock-only enrichment: source=free first (MusicBrainz facts + verified relations), then source=ai grounded on those facts, then one source=ai-deepen pass; never invent - empty graph beats a wrong edge.

nodes.label: No AI on the Audio Path
nodes.rationale: Hard rule: audio playback must never depend on an AI service being available.
nodes.norm_label: no ai on the audio path

nodes.label: Never Invent ICY Titles
nodes.rationale: When ICY is empty the UI stays honest; silent stations remain sparse rather than fabricating a track title.

nodes.label: Promise.race over AbortController
nodes.rationale: AbortController.abort() on a Remix server fetch can crash the process; timeouts must race with Promise.race instead.

nodes.label: Card Stack Experience
nodes.rationale: Replace static summaries with an interactive swipeable stack: evocative mood labels, rich storytelling, per-station highlights, animation cues, progressive reveal.

nodes.label: Scene Animation Cues
nodes.rationale: slow_pan for mellow moods, slow_orbit for balanced sets, cascade_drop for high energy so motion matches sonic vibe.

nodes.label: Preview-on-hover Playback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Default preview_on_hover lets listeners explore before committing; autoplay_first reserved for high-energy sets.

nodes.label: One Room Principle
nodes.rationale: One object, one key: the previous station is gone on the next frame so a leftover caption can never sit under a new city.

nodes.label: Radio Browser Catalog
nodes.rationale: CORS and mixed-content failures are real properties of the catalog; retry then skip, never fake a healthy catalog.

nodes.label: Country Center Geo Fallback
nodes.rationale: Search catalogs often omit geo_lat/geo_long; country centers (ISO code) keep the globe lit, but centers are locator-only and never written onto Station.

nodes.label: Sky Becomes Knowledge Pass
nodes.rationale: The constellation becomes a real graph: MusicBrainz relations and the cover AI return nodes and edges; nothing is invented.

nodes.label: Mantine Removal
nodes.rationale: First load drops MantineProvider and leftover travel-stack CSS so Tailwind scans only mounted product files.

nodes.label: Day / Night Room
nodes.rationale: Day is a morning-edition paper palette, not a white SaaS invert; tokens flip on data-atmosphere and a boot script prevents a night flash.

nodes.label: Missing Meridian Wound
nodes.rationale: The disc must never travel a hop that is not stroked; dimmed proximity mesh and teleport hops left the disc crossing empty sky.

nodes.label: FIELD_TRIANGLE_CAP
nodes.rationale: O(n^3) triangles at ~25 nodes compounded translucent fills into opaque foil; capped to the tightest 14 faces.

nodes.label: FIELD_DEGREE_CAP
nodes.rationale: Each star keeps its strongest 3 threads so a filed sky stops roping everything to everything; spans guarantee connectivity.

nodes.label: Scroll Sky Fold
nodes.rationale: Folding shortens the page, so it only engages above SKY_FOLD_MIN_ROOM of readable page or it claws the scroll back on shallow rooms.

nodes.label: MusicBrainz Verified Relations
nodes.rationale: inc=artist-rels+work-rels returns real relationships converted into verified TriviaGraph edges; true edges even when the AI is down; MB wins on conflict; empty graph beats a wrong edge.

nodes.label: source=ai-deepen Second-Ring Pass
nodes.rationale: One slow bloom per track ~8-15s after filed so the sky visibly grows; silence on failure, never an error state.

nodes.label: Star Birth Ripple
nodes.rationale: 600ms ring ripple plus bloom overshoot makes the second-ring pass visible as a found-new-note beat.

nodes.label: Relation Word Mid-Edge Label
nodes.rationale: Painting wrote/composed mid-edge while the disc transits makes the graph legible.

nodes.label: Ship Flow (test, commit, push main, vercel --prod)
nodes.norm_label: ship flow (test, commit, push main, vercel --prod)

nodes.label: Product Locks
nodes.rationale: Locks survive every ship: never charge to hear radio, never invent ICY titles, never AI on the audio path, Promise.race not abort, voice words and banned words.

nodes.label: Night / Day Token System
nodes.rationale: Live values on :root and :root[data-atmosphere=day]; Tailwind color names point at CSS vars; Night is the default room.

nodes.label: Lacquer #C73A3A
nodes.rationale: Lacquer is the play/ink/land color and never changes between Night and Day.

nodes.label: Elsewhere Voice Lexicon
nodes.rationale: Voice words land, dusk, hour, stamp, live, cover, elsewhere, now define the editorial register of every surface.

nodes.label: Banned Words
nodes.rationale: discover, seamless, AI-powered, widget, playlist, unlock, explore are banned to keep the product voice.

nodes.label: .ew-land Customs Stamp Control
nodes.rationale: Landing is what inks the passport; the control is the stamp, so pressing it drops 2px into the page.

nodes.label: Passage Motion System (--ew-settle)
nodes.rationale: Every room arrives the same way with one settle ease, transform/opacity only, all off under prefers-reduced-motion; a settle, never a bounce.

nodes.label: Cloudflare DNS-only Zone
nodes.rationale: Orange-cloud proxy breaks Vercel certificates, so records must stay grey-cloud DNS only.

nodes.label: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash
nodes.rationale: Flash-Lite is a fallback, not the default; env edits on Vercel need a redeploy to take effect.

nodes.label: localStorage Playback Persistence
nodes.rationale: Only minimal playback fields persist so serialized payloads stay small; SSR/test helpers no-op for one code path.

nodes.label: Pretext Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: Layout first, animation second, DOM measurement last or never - avoids forced reflow and hydration mismatch on variable-length live metadata.

nodes.label: Elastic Headline Surface
nodes.rationale: Letters scatter inside stable word anchors derived from Pretext-computed lines instead of DOM-measured home coordinates.

nodes.label: Hero Hydration Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Server and first client render must emit identical text; interactive physics activates only after mount.

nodes.label: Correspondent Paid Desk
nodes.rationale: USD 6/mo or 60/yr selling the desk: unlimited mix, filed dispatch, probe-ahead skip, synced book. Streams, globe, atlas, Land here stay free; never named Premium.

nodes.label: Probe-ahead Silent Skip
nodes.rationale: Prefer HTTPS/non-mixed-content stations; keep auto-skip but do not fake a working catalog.

nodes.label: Correspondent Kill Gate
nodes.rationale: Kill the experiment if 200-plus qualified users with checkout start under 1.5%, or AI COGS above 35% of MRR.

nodes.label: View Transitions Seam
nodes.rationale: Home-theater navigation runs through the View Transitions API so the globe dissolves into the theater sky; browsers without VT fall back untouched.

nodes.label: Intent Echo Feature
nodes.rationale: Whisper what the interpreter understood so a rewrite reads as conversation, not a glitch; cleared on the next keystroke.

nodes.label: queryRef Staleness Guard
nodes.rationale: A slow interpret response must never whisper over text the visitor already retyped.

nodes.label: Tailwind @layer Drop Gremlin
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v3 nondeterministically drops rules inside @layer components, so site-bar and stamp CSS live outside any layer at the end of tailwind.css.

nodes.label: softFail Snapshot Timeout
nodes.rationale: An outage must not look like an empty end: 503 snapshot-unavailable plus client Try-again instead of a silent empty list.

nodes.label: Parallel Agent Dispatch Worktrees
nodes.rationale: Three native subagents with exclusive file boundaries in isolated git worktrees; external CLIs cannot run under the sandbox.

nodes.label: Product Loop (land-intent-tune-inhabit-stamp-next)
nodes.rationale: A control that does not take the listener to the next step is a dead icon.

nodes.label: Every Empty State Offers a Next Step
nodes.rationale: Empty or failed surfaces must offer a button; copy-only is a dead end; unmounted leftovers get no tests.
nodes.norm_label: every empty state offers a next step

nodes.label: theaterPhase States
nodes.rationale: reading, locking, filed, quiet; filed keeps the sky lit so filing does not empty it.

nodes.label: Lacquer Disc Traveler
nodes.rationale: The brand mark reads the sleeve: walks real edges, names the star it rests on, never resets when the node list grows.

nodes.label: Single ICY Poller Ownership
nodes.rationale: Second pollers caused the restart-and-snap bug; the dock owns the only ICY poller and Home and Theater only read the Room.

nodes.label: Settled Constellation Story
nodes.rationale: The disc walks everything the station has told you; filing does not empty the sky; seats stay.

nodes.label: Tailscale MagicDNS Interference
nodes.rationale: dig resolves but getaddrinfo fails means Tailscale DNS; turn off Use Tailscale DNS, never change public records.

nodes.label: Solar Hour Filter
nodes.rationale: Filters by the city local hour, not the listener clock; never stops audio.

nodes.label: Empty State Names the Next Move
nodes.rationale: Every empty or failed surface offers a button; copy without a button is a dead end.
nodes.norm_label: empty state names the next move

nodes.label: Elsewhere Product
nodes.rationale: Live radio as a fashion cover of a city awake without you; stay sixty seconds and the city inks your passport; repo heritage name Radio Passport.
